filled_by.method: each truth_access_tier was read off the vendor's own pricing page (or, where the pricing page was silent, the vendor's own API overview), not off the developer docs the pipeline had cited
filled_by.caveat: the queue was designed for a human, because a second model reading the same class of page is not independent of the first. Filled this way the check still discriminates -- it compares pricing pages against docs pages, which is the distinction the test turns on -- but it is weaker than the human check it substitutes for, and a human should re-check at least the four false negatives before the result is quoted as settled
